children: Hong Kong food and catering group's H1 revenue fell 4.5% yr/yr on lower restaurant sales
Company posted net loss attributable to owners, reversing a profit a year earlier
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for future quarters or the full year in the press release
JAPANESE RESTAURANT SALES - Co said lower turnover in food and catering business was mainly due to decreased sales at Japanese restaurants
FOOD SOUVENIR SALES - Co said lower turnover in food souvenir business was mainly due to decrease in retail and corporate sales
STEADY RENTAL INCOME - Property investment segment contributed steady rental income, with no fair value gain or loss recognized
